CONSULTING AGREEMENT

This Consulting Agreement (the "Agreement") is made between Harrow Analytics Ltd ("Client") and the consultant named on the signature page ("Consultant").

1. Engagement. Client may issue assignments to Consultant in the form attached to this Agreement. Consultant will render the services described in each assignment accepted by Consultant. Consultant will be free of control and direction from Client, and Consultant will have exclusive control over the manner and means of performing the services. Consultant will provide, at Consultant's own expense, a place of work and all equipment needed to complete the services.

2. Payment. Client will pay Consultant within thirty days of invoice. Consultant will invoice Client monthly. Client will reimburse Consultant for expenses Client approved in writing before Consultant incurred them. Client owes Consultant nothing for an assignment Client did not accept.

3. Independent contractor. Consultant is not an employee of Client, and Consultant is responsible for income and employment taxes on every amount Client pays Consultant. Nothing in this Agreement makes Consultant an agent of Client, and Consultant may not bind Client to any obligation. Consultant will not represent to anybody that Consultant speaks for Client.

4. Confidentiality. Confidential information disclosed under this Agreement stays with the receiving party ("Recipient"). Recipient will not disclose it to anybody. Recipient will return every copy on request. The Recipient remains bound after this Agreement ends, and the Recipient will tell the disclosing party at once if the Recipient learns of any disclosure. Recipient will protect the information with the care Recipient uses for its own.

5. Term. This Agreement begins on the effective date and continues until Client or Consultant ends it on thirty days notice. Consultant will return all Client property when this Agreement ends.
